RankZeroLemma.cite: Standard: if J(F) is finite and X has no F-rational map to P^1 of degree <= d, then X has finitely many closed points of degree <= d over F (the fibres of Sym^d X -> Pic^d X over the finitely many F-points are projective spaces, and a positive-dimensional fibre is a base-point-free pencil of degree <= d).
